voice.name: Harry - Fierce Warrior
voice.why: The gate guard is young, tense and holds a rifle he has never had to fire: short sentences, no patience for strangers. Harry is a young, rough American voice, nothing like the quartermaster's measured calm or the buyer's husky patter, and no other speaker uses this voice. Both gate guards play this one dialogue.

greet.text: Hold it there. This is not a public road. State your business or turn around.

trade.text: Quartermaster is past the fire. Keep your hands where I can see them and touch nothing that is not yours.

stranger.text: Strangers. Uniforms. Anyone nobody here has vouched for. Right now that is you.

uniform.text: Then you can turn around. Nobody here wants that badge in the camp. Go back the way you came.
